map.这个公式适合多大红移？: Up to what redshift is this formula suitable?
map.仅适合低红移（z≪1）。高红移需考虑宇宙膨胀历史与暗能量，用完整宇宙学距离积分。: It is only suitable at low redshift (z much less than 1). At high redshift the expansion history of the universe and dark energy must be considered, using the full cosmological distance integral.
map.哈勃常数 H₀ 的取值影响大吗？: Does the choice of the Hubble constant H0 matter much?
map.很大。H₀ 当前测量存在约 70 与 73 km/s/Mpc 之争，会成比例地改: Very much. Current measurements of H0 disagree between about 70 and 73 km/s/Mpc, which changes the distance estimates proportionally.
